jobs.description:
Production Operator with Technical Insight Wanted in Kampenhout!

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Your Responsibilities

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.
• Checking materials at the production line.
• Replenishing labels, packaging materials, and other production supplies.
• Manually packing finished products into boxes.
• Performing quality checks on weight, dosage, and product finish.
• Adjusting and fine-tuning machine settings when necessary.
• Monitoring the supply and flow of liquids throughout the process.
• Connecting new tanks to the production system.

Technical Follow-Up

• Detecting malfunctions and assisting in resolving them together with the technician.
• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.

REF:MEC1

• You have experience working on a production line.
• You work in a highly responsible and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on quality and safety.
• You are organized and tidy; you remove production waste and clean your workstation before handing it over to colleagues on the next shift.
• You are hands-on and capable of lifting and handling heavy objects with ease.
• You are eager to learn and support your colleagues; a technical background or education in mechanics or electrical/electronics engineering is a strong advantage, whether completed or not.
• You are dynamic and able to perform well under pressure.
• You are flexible and willing to work in different shifts (6:00 AM – 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) and/or in the day shift (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM), depending on production needs. The same flexibility applies to overtime.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

Embark on an exciting career journey with a Traineeship in Recruitment & Sales, where you will develop expertise in matching talent with opportunities while honing your sales skills. This position offers a unique opportunity to grow within the business services industry in 1050 Bruxelles.

Client Details

Page Personnel is a recruitment agency specialized in placing junior to mid-level professionals in temporary and permanent roles across finance, sales, administration, and technical functions.

Description

As a Traineeship Recruitment & Sales professional, your responsibilities are:

• Engaging with clients to understand their recruitment needs and business objectives.
• Identifying and sourcing suitable candidates through various channels.
• Providing tailored recruitment solutions to meet client requirements.
• Building and maintaining strong client and candidate relationships.
• Managing the recruitment process from start to finish, including interviews and feedback.
• Preparing and presenting proposals to clients.
• Collaborating with the sales team to identify new business opportunities.
• Ensuring timely and accurate reporting of recruitment activities.

A successful Traineeship Recruitment & Sales professional should have:

• A degree in a relevant field such as business, human resources, or a related discipline.
• A strong interest in recruitment and sales within the business services industry.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
• A proactive attitude and a desire to learn and grow professionally.
• Organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
• Proficiency in English, Dutch & French;

HEIMWEE is looking for social media & content interns for their 3 brands:
 
 

• MXDVS 

• Objects by Max Reynders 

• Garments by Max Reynders  

 
 

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Marketing Intern to join us on-site and help bring our three brands to life across social media and content. You'll work closely with the team to plan, create, and publish content that fits each brand's distinct identity while getting hands-on experience with the day-to-day of running marketing for a multi-brand company.
 

 
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Plan and create content (photo & video) for Instagram and TikTok across our three brands 

• Help maintain and grow our content calendar, keeping each brand consistent 

• Support community management: replying to comments and DMs, monitoring engagement, spotting trends and translating them into our identity 

• Assist with campaign planning around product launches and collections 

• Track and report on content performance, and help translate insights into next steps 

• Collaborate with the design and product teams to make sure marketing content reflects what's actually happening in the brands  

 
 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Currently studying marketing, communication, or a related field (or recently graduated) 

• A genuine interest in social media, content creation, fashion, and/or design 

• Comfortable creating content yourself 

• Familiar with Instagram, TikTok, and content/scheduling tools 

• Proactive, organized, and happy to work on-site as part of a small team 

• Fluent in English  

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• A small creative team where your ideas are heard 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV, a short motivation and a portfolio or examples of content you've made to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

Send your CV to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

HEIMWEE is looking for customer service interns for their 3 brands:

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Customer Service Intern to join us on-site and and be the friendly voice behind our three brands. You'll be the first point of contact for customers and helping us keep the same care and attention we put into our products in every conversation.

• Strong written communication skills and a genuine, patient, customer-first attitude 

• Organized and comfortable managing multiple conversations at once 

• Interest in fashion, design, or furniture is a plus 

• Fluent in English  

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• Real responsibility: you'll be trusted to represent Heimwee in every interaction 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

HEIMWEE is looking for Supply Chain Management interns for their 3 brands:
 
 

• MXDVS 

• Objects by Max Reynders 

• Garments by Max Reynders  

 
 

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Supply Chain Management Intern to join us on-site and help keep production and logistics running smoothly across our three brands. From fabric to furniture, you'll get hands-on exposure to how a multi-brand company sources materials, coordinates production, and gets finished products to customers on time.
 

 
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Support day-to-day coordination with suppliers and production partners across our brands 

• Help track purchase orders, lead times, and delivery schedules 

• Monitor stock levels and assist with inventory planning to avoid shortages or overstock 

• Support the coordination of shipments and logistics, both inbound (materials) and outbound (orders to customers) 

• Help identify bottlenecks in the supply chain and suggest improvements 

• Maintain accurate records of suppliers, orders, and stock 

• Work closely with the operations, marketing, and customer service teams to align on product availability  

 
 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Currently studying supply chain management, logistics, business, or a related field 

• Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with data and spreadsheets 

• Interest in production and sourcing, ideally in fashion and/or furniture 

• Proactive problem-solver who's comfortable coordinating with multiple parties 

• Fluent in English  

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• Real responsibility and visibility into how products move from supplier to customer 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

An international Tech company supports leading organizations in managing complex, large-scale projects across industries such as construction, infrastructure and energy. By combining technology, data and project management expertise, they improve their overall processes.
The company operates globally with a strong collaborative culture, where knowledge sharing, quality and continuous learning are key. In Belgium, you’ll join a team, working closely with international colleagues on impactful projects.

Jobomschrijving

In this role you support clients in their digital transformation of their project management processes. You analyze how their projects are structured and managed, and translate this into efficient solutions using specialized tools.
You guide implementations from analysis to implementation, ensuring that systems are aligned with business needs and project realities. You work closely with business stakeholders to understand their challenges, define processes and configure solutions that improve visibility, planning and decision-making.
In this role, you combine project insight with technical understanding, acting as a bridge between engineering, operations and IT. While you work independently on assignments, you also collaborate with colleagues consultants when needed and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

• Master’s degree in Engineering (Civil or Construction) or Business Engineering
• You have at least a first strong working experience
• Knowledge of Project Management (managing scope, timing & budget...)
• You combine analytical thinking with strong communication skills
• You are OK with working very independently after training/onboarding
• You are fluent in English (additional languages such as Dutch or French are a plus)

jobs.occupation: Fulltime Kitchen Crew Member - Brussels Center
jobs.description:
Do you like the smell of freshly prepared food, the buzz of a packed venue, and the idea of working where people come to enjoy great beers and good times? Then keep reading.
 

At 
Bier Central Brussels, we're looking for a 
full-time Kitchen Crew Member to strengthen our team. We're not searching for the next Michelin-star chef (unless you secretly are one), but we are looking for someone who enjoys working in a professional kitchen, loves a lively atmosphere, and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves when things get busy.
 

 
 

What you'll be doing:
 
 

• Helping prepare our delicious dishes. 

• Keeping the kitchen organized, clean, and efficient. 

• Working closely with an enthusiastic team that knows how to work hard and laugh even harder. 

• Delivering quality dishes, even when the restaurant is packed and the beer is flowing. 

* You already have some experience in a professional kitchen.
 

* You can communicate comfortably in 
English. If you speak additional languages, that's a huge bonus. 
 

* You live 
in or near Brussels city centre. Let's be honest: relying on public transport after a late closing shift is not always the happiest part of the job.
 

* You actually 
enjoy weekend work. While most people are planning their weekend, you'll be right in the middle of the action, the atmosphere, and the excitement. Those are our busiest and most fun moments.
 

* You bring a positive attitude, team spirit, and a willingness to learn.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the enterprise-wide data architecture that supports critical business initiatives and drives data-driven decision-making. You'll shape the structure, governance, and strategic roadmap of data assets across the organization¿ensuring data is accessible, secure, integrated, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You'll collaborate with senior stakeholders in IT, analytics, and the business to architect scalable data solutions across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments¿balancing innovation with long-term sustainability.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and evolve enterprise data architecture, aligning with business strategies and regulatory requirements.
• Lead data modelling efforts across operational and analytical domains (OLTP/OLAP), including conceptual, logical, and physical models.
• Promote a hands-on, pragmatic approach towards data architecture and the overall team dynamic
• Define and implement data standards, policies, and governance frameworks.
• Guide the architecture of data platforms, support self-service, AI, Dashboarding and real-time streaming solutions.
• Partner with Data Engineers, Analysts, Architects, and Business stakeholders to ensure data quality, accessibility, and lineage.
• Influence senior stakeholders and business owners across the organisation (38K, global)
• Evaluate and recommend technologies and tools for data integration, storage, cataloguing, and analytics.
• Ensure data architecture enables AI/ML, advanced analytics, and reporting initiatives.
• Support compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, or other regulatory standards depending on the region/industry.
• Provide architectural oversight and leadership across data-related projects and programs.
• Mentor junior data architects and engineers, contributing to a strong data architecture community. 
We do not only deliver letters and parcels, but also opportunities. This job is open to all with diverse backgrounds and talents, possessing the following profile:  
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in large scale data architecture or related fields (over 100m events); 3+ years in a senior or enterprise role.
• Strong hands-on expertise in data architecture design for cloud (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid environments.
• Deep knowledge of data modelling techniques, ETL/ELT pipelines, automation (CICD scripting, Airflow...) and data lifecycle management.
• Experience with streaming data is a strong asset (Kafka, Flink...). Experience with Semantic integration and Ontology also assets.
• Familiarity with modern data stacks: Snowflake, Databricks, DBT, etc.
• Understanding of data security, master data management (MDM), data mesh, and metadata management.
• Excellent communication (business fluent English, French and/or Dutch are a plus) and leadership skills with the ability to translate complex data topics for business audiences.
• Experience working in Agile or DevOps environments is a plus.
• 2 days per week (minimum) hybrid office presence. 
Like a long-awaited parcel, we want to make you feel welcome and valued. Our offer includes:  

·       Competitive monthly salary 

·       Meal vouchers 

·       Hospitalization-, group- and disability insurances 

·       A phone subscription and company car 

·       20 days of statutory leave and 7 additional extralegal days off  

·       An end-of-year and performance-based bonus and double holiday pay  

·       Many benefits from more than 100 bpost-partners 

 

Why bpostgroup? 

bpostgroup is Belgium's leading postal operator and a growing parcel & omni-commerce logistics partner globally. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, we aim to be a trusted guide in a changing world. As our newest team member you will:  

·       Become part of the bpostgroup family with a unique atmosphere and culture. 

·       Enjoy a dynamic work environment with a hybrid model allowing for flexibility. 

·       Have access to continuous learning and development opportunities. 

·       Have a direct impact on decision-making in an international success story. 

·       Thrive in a leadership culture centered on visioning, sense making, innovation, and relating, empowering you to lead effectively in our forward-thinking organization.  

Find out more about bpostgroup   

#LI-DNI 

No match?  

Explore other exciting job opportunities with us.

Jobomschrijving

• Strong analytical mindset with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.

• Fluent in English with strong communication skills; additional languages are considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - Real Estate / Corporate - Walloon Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading European real estate developer specializing in sustainable urban projects, including office and residential developments, with ESG principles embedded across its activities.

The company operates internationally with a strong footprint in several European markets, combining local expertise with a centralized structure. Belgium remains a key market within its portfolio.

It fosters an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture, driven by innovation and sustainability, offering exposure to complex, cross-border projects and stakeholders.

The legal department is currently evolving, providing opportunities to contribute to its structure and expand beyond traditional real estate legal work.

Jobomschrijving

Real Estate & Transactions

• Draft and negotiate real estate contracts (leases, sales, partnerships, construction, etc.)
• Support acquisitions and disposals of real estate assets
• Structure transactions and manage due diligence processes
• Coordinate and manage external legal counsel

Project & Business Support

• Advise project developers and country directors on legal aspects
• Support development projects from structuring to execution
• Participate in bidding processes and project set-ups

Corporate & Additional Exposure

• Handle corporate structuring and housekeeping
• Draft shareholders' agreements and manage SPVs
• Contribute to compliance and internal legal organization if interested

Litigation

• Manage disputes and liaise with external counsel

• Master's degree in Law (Belgian university)
• Minimum 5-8 years of experience in real estate law (law firm, developer or similar)
• Strong experience in real estate transactions, contracting
• Exposure to corporate law

Languages

• Fluent French (deal language)
• Strong English (corporate environment)

Personal Skills

• Autonomous and proactive
• Strong team player with collaborative mindset
• Pragmatic, business-oriented and detail-focused
• Able to interact with senior stakeholders
• High ethical standards and professional integrity

What you do

 
• 
You research new applications and functionality for business use cases.

 
• 
You build new processes as well as optimize existing ones.

 
• 
You rollout the template to new factories and countries.

 
• 
You work closely together with the business process owners.

 
• 
You participate in the blueprint and fit-gap.

 
• 
You understand the business processes and requirements.

 
• 
You convert them into a functional design.

 
• 
You configure the system and write functional and technical specifications.

 
• 
You document and test the functionality.

 
• 
You support the business during acceptance and go-live.

 
• 
You play a key role in all phases from the beginning till the end.

 
• 
You work with the latest SAP technologies and applications (including S/4 Hana).

Who you are

 
• 
You have built up profound knowledge of SAP SD (sales and distribution)

 
• 
You are familiar with the business processes and their approach in SAP

 
• 
You have developed analytical skills

 
• 
You have a proactive and solution oriented mindset

 
• 
You prefer working in an informal no-nonsense style

 
• 
You work independently and collaborate in dialogue with colleagues

 
• 
You are interested in a manufacturing environment

 
• 
You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe

 
• 
You speak English (Dutch or French is a plus)

 
• 
You are able to debug programming code

Are you the kind of person who can spot a perfectly poured beer faster than a bad joke? 

Do you love a bustling hospitality environment, fun coworkers, and a bar that’s never boring? 

Then we’re sure to have your next challenge waiting for you.
 

Bier Central Brussels is looking for a full-time bartender to join the team.
 

What will you be doing?
 

- Pouring beer as if it were an art form. 

- Welcome guests with a smile. 

- Take orders and serve drinks. 

- Keep the bar clean and organized. 

- Help create the lively atmosphere that Bier Central is known for.

- Ideally, you already have some serious experience working behind a bar.

- You live in Brussels.

- You don’t rely on public transportation. We close between midnight and 1:00 a.m., so being able to get home on your own is important.

- Working on weekends is a given for you.

- You understand and speak French at a basic level.

- You speak and understand English. Other languages? Those are just bonus points.

jobs.occupation: COMPLIANCE DATA AND REPORTING OFFICER, Junior role M/W/X
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Compliance Data and Reporting Officer to support the Compliance function in strengthening the quality, reliability, and efficiency of its data, reporting, and information management processes. This is a junior role designed for a rigorous and analytical profile who is comfortable working with data, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and contributing to the continuous improvement of compliance processes in a fast-growing fintech environment. 

In this role, you will help ensure the timely preparation, coordination, and delivery of compliance reports, including periodic and ad hoc data regulatory reporting. You will maintain reporting calendars, monitor deadlines, support the collection and validation of relevant data, and contribute to the production of accurate and structured reporting outputs for internal stakeholders and, where applicable, regulators. 

The position will contribute to broader compliance management initiatives aimed at improving the use of tools and technology within the Compliance function, including reporting workflows, JIRA-based tracking, data visualisation, automation, and AI-supported information processing. Through these activities, you will play an important role in helping Compliance teams make better use of data, reduce manual effort, and enhance the reliability of management information. 

The position reports functionally and administratively to the Global Head of Regulatory Affairs. 
 
What you will do  

• Maintain reporting calendars and ensure timely delivery of all compliance reports 
• Work closely with product and data team for regulatory periodic and ad hoc reporting  
• Support enhancements to digital onboarding data capture and KYC process automation 
• Support data quality initiatives to ensure accuracy and completeness of compliance reporting 
• Identify opportunities for data process optimization and automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort 
• Provide data insights and analytical support to Compliance Officers and first-line teams 
• Identify practical obstacles to data quality and reporting processes 
• Escalate data-related issues and improvement needs to appropriate owners 
• Support in transmitting reports to regulators of some designated countries 
• Support any compliance management initiatives aiming at enhancing compliance data processing and visualiztion (e.g. JIRA) and information processing (AI) 

What do you bring? 
• You hold a master's degree or equivalent in business law, banking and financial law, financial economics, or a related field 
• You have 1+ year of experience in Fintech or Paytech environment 
• You are rigorous, well-organised, and comfortable working with data and producing structured reports 
• You have strong analytical skills and are able to synthesise complex information into actionable insights 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint and ease of learning other tool capabilities (JIRA, AI) 
• 
You are fluent in English, French is a plus 

 
 
What do we offer? 

• Diverse missions and projects in an innovative and growing Fintech company; 
• A meaningful role within the second line of defence, with real visibility and impact; 
• A professional, international team with a collaborative and flat hierarchy; 
• A dynamic and supportive work environment in Brussels.

Your main responsibilities are arranging transport, preparing customs clearance information, and communicating with forwarders and transport partners. You will also manage item data and handle the processing and registration of purchases.
 
 

• Checking and recording invoices in the inventory system related to export. 

• Checking all kinds of documents (transport documents, certificates of origin, certificates of conformity, EUR1, ...) 

• Preparing and providing information required for customs clearance 

• Following up on open orders and taking action to ensure timely shipment. 

• Communicating with forwarders, transport companies, and customs-related stakeholders, including for transport arrangements. 

• Monitor delivery times and prices, take action where necessary 

• Coordinating with various departments, including Customer Service, to ensure the smooth flow of export operations. 

• Back up to the general administrative tasks to support the department  

 

 

• A customer-oriented mindset and strong problem-solving skills, combined with a collaborative approach, are essential. 

• The ability to work accurately and with attention to detail is important. 

• Knowledge and/or experience in export procedures and international transport is required. 

• An understanding of customs and excise regulations is considered an advantage. 

• Familiarity with Incoterms, together with technical understanding and an affinity for the product range, is a required. 

• Fluency in both French and English, spoken and written, is essential. 

• Good knowledge and hands-on experience with MS Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook, is necessary.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• Angular experience is a big asset
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French
